text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and B at gains felt rewarding, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; use a clear plan rather than my average cost.","My account moved both up and down while I mostly did nothing, and this short history offers no reliable signal about what comes next.","I should review periodically and make decisions using preset portfolio and risk rules—not fear of losses, reluctance to admit a mistake, or the urge to lock in a gain."]}
